text.p: South African striker Sean Dundee hit a hat-trick to help Karlsruhe hammer Arminia Bielefeld 5-2 in the German first division on Friday.

Dundee scored in the 28th, 50th and 68th minutes. In between, Marc Keller and Markus Schroth both found the net to give Karlsruhe, victors over Rapid Bucharest in the UEFA Cup in midweek, their biggest victory of the season.
International striker Stefan Kuntz and Heiko Gerber scored consolation goals for Bielefeld in the last 11 minutes.
Elsewhere, Cologne got back to winning ways with a 2-0 win over Bochum which took them to third place in the table behind Bayern Munich and VfB Stuttgart.
All the remaining Bundesliga sides are in action on Saturday and Sunday.
